evidence.body: [e001:f01] Whether it's investigating the financials of Elon Musk's pro-Trump PAC or producing our latest documentary, 'The A Word', which shines a light on the American women fighting for reproductive rights, we know how important it is to parse out the facts from the messaging. evidence.title: FIA penalty points: Lewis Hamilton and Kimi Antonelli update ahead of Azerbaijan Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e003:f01] As the F1 world championship gets into the business end of the season, every little thing only magnifies in importance and that includes mistakes and mishaps. [e003:f02] That especially includes getting into trouble with the FIA stewards. [e003:f03] Do that enough times by racking up 12 penalty points and a one-race ban is put in place - not ideal for drivers or teams in a championship battle or even otherwise. [e003:f04] The prospect of that happening this season had dimmed in recent weeks though, with a host of drivers having had penalty points expire following recent races. [e003:f05] Article continues under video They usually last a whole calendar year, and that has led to world championship leader Kimi Antonelli seeing three of his four penalty points expire in recent weeks. [e003:f06] F1 HEADLINES: Hamilton escapes, Mercedes masterplan and Verstappen Le Mans statement Penalty points expire for Hamilton and Antonelli Causing a collision with Charles Leclerc at the Dutch Grand Prix last year (2) and driving erratically at Monza last year (1) has left the 20-year-old with just one point. [e003:f07] Likewise, his title rival Lewis Hamilton has also been left with just one penalty point with two being deducted having failed to slow under double yellow flags at last year's Dutch Grand Prix. [e003:f08] While this season the FIA have been far more lenient on dishing out points, three drivers were hit at the Dutch Grand Prix last month with Liam Lawson, Franco Colapinto and Arvid Lindblad picking up points for yellow flag infringements. [e003:f09] As a result, Colapinto is now the driver with the most penalty points with four (all picked up this season), with Lawson and Aston Martin's Lance Stroll both on three. [e003:f10] Esteban Ocon had previously been top of the 'bad boys' with four points, but has had two points deducted following a collision with Carlos Sainz at last year's Italian Grand Prix. [e003:f11] Alex Albon for a similar incident with Ocon himself in Azerbaijan last year has also had two points taken off recently. [e003:f12] Drivers are allowed to a threshold of 12 penalty points and if they exceed that at any time, they are forced into a one-race ban for the next applicable race. [e003:f13] All points picked remain active for one year before expiring.

evidence.title: McLaren to revive H-Wing in Azerbaijan GP updates
evidence.body: [e004:f01] McLaren upgrades revealed for Azerbaijan GP as H-Wing returns McLaren upgrades revealed for Azerbaijan GP as H-Wing returns McLaren confirms H-Wing return among fresh Baku upgrades Henry Valantine 21 Sep 2026 4:43 PM McLaren brought its 'H-Wing' rear wing design to Monza, but it will return after skipping a round. [e004:f02] McLaren has revealed its ‘H-Wing’ upgrade is due to return to the MCL40 at the Azerbaijan Grand Prix, as part of a wider update package. [e004:f03] McLaren had brought its rotating rear wing solution to Monza, though it was not seen on the car at the Spanish Grand Prix last time out. [e004:f04] McLaren reveals return of H-Wing among Azerbaijan GP updates The reigning Drivers’ and Constructors’ champions are heading to Baku with confirmation that further upgrades are coming to its current package. [e004:f05] Alongside the return of the H-Wing, McLaren confirmed an aerodynamic update would be arriving as the team looks to continue challenging at the front. [e004:f06] These parts will be evaluated in free practice, before a decision is made on whether or not they remain on the car throughout the Azerbaijan Grand Prix weekend. [e004:f07] While other teams have already switched substantial focus onto their 2027 cars, McLaren chief technical officer and chief designer, Rob Marshall, acknowledged there is a balancing act in bringing new parts to its car while looking ahead to next year. [e004:f08] “We are still learning about these cars at every event, and we have both overperformed and underperformed against our expectations at different races this season,” Marshall said ahead of the weekend. [e004:f09] “Baku will provide another valuable test of the MCL40 across a very different range of characteristics. [e004:f10] “Energy management and deployment will be particularly important, as will tyre and brake management with the cars arriving at Turn 1 after the long straight with these areas relatively cold. [e004:f11] “Operationally, there is very little margin for error on a tight street circuit. [e004:f12] A small mistake can lead to significant repairs, lost track time and resources being diverted away from performance, so confidence, precision and disciplined execution will be essential throughout the weekend. [e004:f13] Perez concern addressed as Cadillac makes F1 2027 decision “We must balance that with work on next year’s car, but our immediate focus is on delivering more performance and fighting for more victories in 2026, while carrying forward everything we learn. [e004:f14] “We expect any of the top four teams to be capable of winning in Baku, with the chasing pack also getting closer, and we hope to be firmly in the fight at the front.” Lando Norris heads to Azerbaijan fourth in the Drivers’ standings, five points behind third-placed Lewis Hamilton after a race in Madrid which saw the reigning title-holder lose a likely victory. [e004:f15] An ill-timed Virtual Safety Car from Norris’ perspective left him unable to pit from the lead, with Kimi Antonelli taking advantage of the shorter time loss to gain track position and win in Spain. evidence.title: Exolaunch Signs Contract with SpaceX for Starfall Mission
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The agreement marks Exolaunch's major expansion into microgravity research, in-space manufacturing and return-to-Earth transportation. [e005:f02] Exolaunch will serve as a payload integrator for the mission, offering biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, advanced-materials developers, governments, space agencies, research institutions and private organizations an end-to-end pathway to fly experiments and mission-critical payloads aboard Starfall, operate them in the space environment and return them safely to Earth. [e005:f03] “Today, Exolaunch is opening an entirely new chapter in its history. [e005:f04] We are proud to secure our first Starfall mission with SpaceX,” said Jeanne Allarie, Chief Marketing Officer at Exolaunch. [e005:f05] “For years, we have helped satellite operators around the world reach orbit reliably and at scale. [e005:f06] Through this new program, we are extending that trusted model to microgravity research, in-space manufacturing, and return-to-Earth services. [e005:f07] Exolaunch looks forward to bringing its integration experience, global customer network and record of execution to this next generation of missions.” Demand for access to a microgravity environment is growing rapidly, particularly in pharmaceutical development, biotechnology, life sciences and advanced materials, including industrial applications such as semiconductor materials research, crystal growth and optical fiber manufacturing. [e005:f08] Exolaunch's mission aboard Starfall is designed to address these needs. [e005:f09] By aggregating customer demand and managing technical, contractual, logistical and operational requirements, Exolaunch will make Starfall's capabilities accessible to a broader global community. [e005:f10] “SpaceX's Starfall spacecraft presents an opportunity to expand access to microgravity,” said Emilie Marley Siemssen, Vice President of Business Development at Exolaunch. [e005:f11] “The ability to launch, operate and return payloads through a single integrated service is transformative.” The mission builds upon Exolaunch's longstanding collaboration with SpaceX. [e005:f12] Since 2020, Exolaunch has deployed hundreds of customer satellites across dozens of Falcon missions, supporting commercial companies, governments, universities, research organizations and space agencies worldwide. [e005:f13] Exolaunch is now engaging customers and strategic partners for the 2029 mission. [e005:f14] Payload opportunities are expected to include pharmaceutical and biotechnology investigations, life-science experiments, advanced-materials research, in-space manufacturing and technology demonstrations. [e005:f15] Exolaunch's recently announced Exo-1 and Exo-2 missions, which SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket will launch, and its newly secured Starfall mission, reflects the company's evolution from a leading rideshare integrator into a broader global orbital access and space-mobility provider. [e005:f16] Together with EQT Private Equity's ongoing acquisition of Exolaunch, these milestones underscore the company's strong growth trajectory and position it to accelerate international expansion and new service offerings across the space value chain.

evidence.title: 円が157円台に下落、日銀の慎重姿勢と日米金利差が重しに
evidence.body: [e004:f01] 日銀の判断と日本当局の次の一手に、市場の視線が集まっています。 [e004:f02] 円は、日銀が他の主要国の中央銀行と同じペースで金融政策を引き締められるかどうかにトレーダーが懐疑的な見方を示していることから、下落圧力にさらされている。 [e004:f03] これにより、日本と海外の金利差は依然として大きい。 [e004:f04] Reuters〜の発表によると 円は火曜日のアジア時間に一時、1ドル＝157円47銭まで下落した。 [e004:f05] 今回の決定には、金融引き締めに反対する票が2票投じられており、市場はこれを慎重姿勢の表れと受け止めた。 [e004:f06] 米ドル・円相場は年末までに160円まで上昇し、その後、2027年半ばまでに156円へ緩やかに下落すると予想している。 [e004:f07] ユニオン・バンケール・プリヴェのアジア担当シニアエコノミスト、カルロス・カサノバ氏 市場では、日銀が10月に短期金利を1.5％まで引き上げる確率を約30％と見積もっている。 [e004:f08] 最近大きく下落していたニュージーランドドルは、同国中央銀行総裁の発言をトレーダーがタカ派的と受け止めたことから、買い戻された。 [e004:f09] これを受け、ニュージーランドドルは約3カ月ぶりの安値から0.4％前後上昇し、1ニュージーランドドル＝0.5736米ドルとなった。 [e004:f10] 一方、ニュージーランドドルは、政策金利が2.75％にとどまる現状では依然として米ドルより利回りが低いことから、下落圧力にさらされている。 [e004:f11] その他の資産の動向 ユーロは1ユーロ＝1.1476ドルに小幅上昇し、英ポンドは1ポンド＝1.3383ドルに上昇した。 [e004:f12] 月曜日に急騰した暗号資産は、やや下落した。 [e004:f13] ビットコインは前日に8万7000ドルを上回り、8カ月ぶりの高値を付けた後、約2％下落した。 [e004:f14] 他のニュースもお見逃しなく： 日銀の利上げ後も円が下落し、東京による為替介入への警戒が強まっている。 [e004:f15] 円が対ドルで上昇し、週間で約2.5％高となる見通し。 [e004:f16] 日銀の利上げ観測が強まる一方、米雇用統計が今後の為替を左右する。

evidence.body: [e002:f01] 楽曲の原作小説を手がけるのは、『ブラッサム』の主人公のモデルである宇野千代を敬愛し、『蹴りたい背中』『私をくいとめて』『パッキパキ北京』などで知られる小説家・綿矢りさ。 [e002:f02] このたび、その原作小説のタイトルが「桜（はな）の命は不滅なり」に決定したことが発表された。 [e002:f03] 連続テレビ小説『ブラッサム』は、明治・大正・昭和の時代を駆け抜け、自由を求め続けた作家・宇野千代をモデルに描かれる物語。 [e002:f04] “小説を音楽にするユニット”として活動してきたYOASOBIが、綿矢りさによる原作小説「桜（はな）の命は不滅なり」、そして『ブラッサム』の物語と向き合いながら紡ぎ上げた主題歌「咲き誇れ」、どちらも注目していただきたい。 [e002:f05] ◆ ◆ ◆ ◾️YOASOBI・Ayase コメント この度、「ブラッサム」主題歌を担当させていただく運びとなりました。 [e002:f06] 本楽曲を制作するにあたり、宇野千代さんの自伝「生きて行く私」を読み、宇野千代さんの生き方、考えに大変感銘を受け、もっと深く入り込むべきだ、肌で先生のエネルギーを感じるべきだ、そう感じ、先生のご出身地である山口県岩国市へ赴き、先生の故郷の風に導かれるようにこの楽曲を作り上げました。 [e002:f07] 自分にとって本当に本当に大事な楽曲となったこの作品を作る機会を与えてくださったことに「ブラッサム」制作に携わる全ての方へ感謝をお送りするとともに、これからこのドラマを視聴するすべての人に、暖かく強かな風が吹きますようにと願いを込めて、この楽曲を添えさせていただきます。 [e002:f08] ◆ ◆ ◆ ◾️YOASOBI・ikura コメント
